note: A listed test ASSERTS the case (reaching the label is not enough). An empty list is a declared gap. The inventory is source-derived (ai_heuristics.py); test_ai_heuristic_manifest.py keeps both in step.

AIBestReserveSurvivesThreat.summary: B4: the chosen reserve must survive the believed threat.

positive.requirement: a reserve that survives is switched in

negative.requirement: a reserve that would be KO'd is refused

AIEnemyHasReliableFirstKO.summary: Winning-action veto: the selected move reliably KOs (switch veto and B6 item veto).

positive.requirement: a reliable selected KO vetoes the switch and the item

negative.requirement: an unselected or unreliable finisher does not

boundary.requirement: fixed damage and Swift into invulnerability

negative.requirement: kept only when exact: enemy-first keep

AIGetPlayerMoveN.summary: Believed player moveset: revealed moves plus a visible-type guess, at every tier.

positive.requirement: revealed moves and type guesses are returned

negative.requirement: unrevealed moves are hidden; reveals do not follow a switch

boundary.requirement: move reorder keeps the revealed bits

AIHealWouldStillDie.summary: Heal-move futility: would the player still KO after the heal resolves.

boundary.requirement: Rest to full vs half-heal cap

AILayerDamage.summary: AI_DAMAGE: rank damaging moves by simulated delivery; AI_KILL for reliable kills (T2+).

positive.requirement: a reliable kill is ranked as a kill

negative.requirement: a kill that needs luck is not treated as reliable

boundary.requirement: delivery caps and kill-FIRST turn order (Quick Attack, mirrors, unrevealed)

AILayerPlan.summary: AI_PLAN: one T3 strategy plan per turn issues an encourage-only directive.

positive.requirement: a qualifying plan steers the choice

negative.requirement: a plan cannot out-argue a kill, and a disabled move enables no plan

AILayerRedundant.summary: AI_REDUNDANT: eliminates moves whose effect cannot work (all tiers).

positive.requirement: a move that cannot work is penalised out of contention

negative.requirement: a move that can work is left alone

AILayerRisky.summary: AI_RISKY: when losing (player KO threat, no guaranteed win) nudge high-variance moves (T3).

positive.requirement: losing: a powerful-but-inaccurate or high-crit move is nudged

negative.requirement: a guaranteed win of our own keeps the layer silent

boundary.requirement: graded ladder: OHKO vs ordinary unreliable move (F15)

AILayerSmart.summary: AI_SMART: per-effect context scoring through AISmartEffectTable (T2+).

positive.requirement: an effect handler's encouragement reaches the score

negative.requirement: an effect handler's discouragement reaches the score

AILayerThreat.summary: AI_THREAT: under a player KO threat, favour priority kills and acting-first disables, discourage investments and futile heals (T3).

positive.requirement: under a KO threat, an investment move is discouraged and a priority kill encouraged

negative.requirement: with no KO threat the layer is silent

boundary.requirement: acting first vs second decides the disabling-status bonus

AIMoveChoiceModification1.summary: AI_BASIC (vanilla): discourage pure status moves against an already-statused target.

positive.requirement: a status move into a statused target is discouraged

negative.requirement: a status move into a healthy target is not

AIMoveChoiceModification2.summary: AI_SETUP (vanilla, gated F9): encourage stat-setup moves on the first turn out.

positive.requirement: setup is encouraged on the send-out turn

negative.requirement: setup is not encouraged after the first turn

AIMoveChoiceModification3.summary: AI_TYPES (vanilla): encourage super-effective moves, discourage resisted ones.

negative.requirement: a resisted move is discouraged only while a neutral-or-better damaging move exists

boundary.requirement: the last damaging option is not discouraged even if resisted

AIPlayerWouldKO.summary: One-decision KO answer over the believed player moveset.

positive.requirement: a believed lethal move answers YES

boundary.requirement: the cache: hit skips the scan, cleared per decision

AIRedundant_AlreadyStatused.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: pure status (Sleep) into an already-statused target.

AIRedundant_BurnFreezeParaSide.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: damaging move with a burn/freeze/para rider: only a Substitute blocks it.

AIRedundant_ConfusionEffect.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Confuse Ray into a confused or Substitute target.

AIRedundant_Disable.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Disable when the player already has a move disabled.

AIRedundant_DreamEater.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Dream Eater into an awake or Substitute target.

AIRedundant_FocusEnergy.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Focus Energy already active.

AIRedundant_Haze.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Haze with nothing to clear (all stages neutral, no clearable state).

AIRedundant_Heal.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Recover/Softboiled at max HP only.

AIRedundant_LeechSeed.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Leech Seed into a Grass, seeded or Substitute target.

AIRedundant_LightScreen.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Light Screen already up on our side.

AIRedundant_Mist.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Mist already up on our side.

AIRedundant_OHKO.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: OHKO moves unless strictly faster.

AIRedundant_Paralyze.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Thunder Wave: statused, Substitute, or Ground vs Electric only.

positive.requirement: Ground target of an Electric paralysis: eliminated

AIRedundant_Poison.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: poison status: statused, Poison-type or Substitute target.

AIRedundant_PoisonSide.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: damaging move with a poison rider: only a Substitute blocks it.

AIRedundant_Reflect.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Reflect already up on our side.

AIRedundant_StatDown.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: stat-down: Substitute, or the stat already at -6 (F17).

AIRedundant_StatUp.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: stat-up: our stat already at +6 (cap $D).

AIRedundant_SubOnly.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: flinch/confusion riders and drain: blocked only by a Substitute.

AIRedundant_Substitute.summary: AI_REDUNDANT handler: Substitute already up, or HP <= max/4 (the engine's fail threshold).

positive.requirement: HP at or below a quarter: eliminated

AIRevalidateDecisionCaches.summary: Player-first cache reuse by state keys (FOLLOWUPS #48).

positive.requirement: unchanged inputs: reused and equal to a rescan

boundary.requirement: HP drop flips NO to YES without a rescan

AISacrificeBeatsSwitch.summary: B5: stay and sacrifice when the active mon is low or the switch costs the reserve half its HP.

positive.requirement: low-value active or costly switch: stay

AISelectSendOut.summary: Send-out ranking: resist the believed threat types; HP/status penalties.

negative.requirement: the active mon and fainted counters are excluded; state restored

AIShouldSwitch.summary: Switch decision: KO threat, frozen/long sleep, trapped and slower; grace period; winning-action veto; T0/T1 vanilla.

negative.requirement: no trigger, grace period, or a reliable winning move keeps us in

boundary.requirement: veto edge cases: unreliable, disabled, paralysed, charging, trapped, invulnerable

AISmart_BurnFreezeParaSide.summary: AI_SMART handler: status riders: +1 when the rider can land; burn +1 vs a physical threat; paralysis +1 when it flips turn order.

positive.requirement: burn rider vs a dominant physical attacker gains a point

negative.requirement: burn rider vs a dominant special attacker gains nothing

boundary.requirement: rider blocked by type or existing status

AISmart_Charge.summary: AI_SMART handler: exposed two-turn moves give away a turn and a hit; Dig is invulnerable.

negative.requirement: Solar Beam-style exposed charge is penalised

AISmart_Confusion.summary: AI_SMART handler: Confuse Ray loses value as the target gets low; PARAFUSION bonus.

AISmart_ConfusionSide.summary: AI_SMART handler: confusion riders: bonus unless already confused.

AISmart_DrainHP.summary: AI_SMART handler: drain moves are worth more when we are not at full HP.

AISmart_DreamEater.summary: AI_SMART handler: Dream Eater into a sleeping target is encouraged.

AISmart_Evasion.summary: AI_SMART handler: Double Team/Minimize scored by whether the boost is worth the turn (F14).

AISmart_Explode.summary: AI_SMART handler: Explosion is a trade: bad at high HP, acceptable when nearly dead; into a Substitute it is always bad.

positive.requirement: low HP (no Substitute): the trade is acceptable

negative.requirement: into a Substitute, at any HP, it is discouraged

AISmart_FlinchSide.summary: AI_SMART handler: flinch riders matter only when we act first (PARA-FLINCH F20).

AISmart_Haze.summary: AI_SMART handler: Haze scored as a trade: what it takes from each side (review F7).

boundary.requirement: our burn/paralysis penalty restoration counts only while in effect

AISmart_Heal.summary: AI_SMART handler: Recover/Softboiled is good when low, wasteful when healthy.

AISmart_HyperBeam.summary: AI_SMART handler: Hyper Beam's recharge is worth it healthy, risky when low.

AISmart_InvulnerableCharge.summary: AI_SMART handler: Fly/Dig: smaller penalty, boosted back when stalling.

AISmart_OHKO.summary: AI_SMART handler: OHKO needs our level above the target's.

positive.requirement: equal or higher level: not discouraged

AISmart_Paralyze.summary: AI_SMART handler: Thunder Wave: strongly preferred when it flips turn order; wasted on a nearly dead target; PARAFUSION with confusion.

positive.requirement: paralysis that flips turn order is strongly preferred

negative.requirement: a nearly dead target is not worth paralysing

AISmart_Poison.summary: AI_SMART handler: Toxic worth more against a long-lived target than a nearly dead one.

AISmart_PoisonSide.summary: AI_SMART handler: poison riders: bonus when the rider can land.

AISmart_RecoilEffect.summary: AI_SMART handler: recoil moves: the recoil must not kill us for less than it gains.

positive.requirement: recoil of at least 1 kills a 1 HP user and is penalised

negative.requirement: breaking a Substitute is not an owner KO trade

AISmart_Screen.summary: AI_SMART handler: Reflect/Light Screen is a turn-1 investment; discouraged once damaged.

AISmart_Sleep.summary: AI_SMART handler: sleep is worth more when we also know Dream Eater.

positive.requirement: sleep + Dream Eater in the moveset is encouraged more

negative.requirement: sleep without Dream Eater gets no extra

AISmart_SpeedDown1.summary: AI_SMART handler: String Shot-style: AI_STRONG when it flips turn order (B2).

boundary.requirement: prediction includes the earned Speed boost

AISmart_SpeedDown2.summary: AI_SMART handler: two-stage Speed drop: same contract as SpeedDown1 at -2.

AISmart_SpeedUp1.summary: AI_SMART handler: one-stage Speed boost: same contract as Agility at +1.

AISmart_SpeedUp2.summary: AI_SMART handler: Agility: AI_STRONG when it flips turn order (B2).

AISmart_StatDownSide.summary: AI_SMART handler: stat-down riders: Substitute-gated; Speed drop +1 when it flips.

positive.requirement: a Speed-drop rider that flips turn order gains a point

AISmart_Substitute.summary: AI_SMART handler: Substitute below half HP is a bad trade.

AISmart_SuperFang.summary: AI_SMART handler: Super Fang is left to AI_DAMAGE's real estimate (no nudge).

positive.requirement: estimate is half the target's current HP, minimum 1

negative.requirement: no extra encouragement at low target HP

AISmart_Trapping.summary: AI_SMART handler: re-using a trapping move on a trapped target wastes the turn.

AISoftPersonalityControl.summary: Soft personality (Codex's track): one-point preference for disruption (PSYCHIC_TR).

negative.requirement: never overturns legality, a stronger score or a reliable KO

AISoftPersonalityDefensive.summary: Soft personality: one-point preference for useful defensive moves (HIKER), only when the tactical layers left them at the neutral baseline.

positive.requirement: Recover below half HP, a screen at full HP that isn't up, a Defense boost at half HP or more below the cap, and Substitute at half HP or more are nudged; full dispatch then picks the defensive move

negative.requirement: outside those HP/state guards nothing is nudged, non-neutral scores are left alone, and a reliable KO or a plan's choice is never overturned

AISoftPersonalityOffense.summary: Soft personality (Codex's track): one-point preference for direct damage (BLACKBELT).

positive.requirement: damaging and fixed-damage moves are nudged

negative.requirement: never overturns legality, a stronger score or a reliable KO

AITrackExecutedEnemyMove.summary: L1: history records the executed move once per decision.

positive.requirement: an executed move extends the streak

negative.requirement: a flinched turn does not count

boundary.requirement: the streak saturates below the flag bit

AITrackLastMove.summary: Decision entry: fresh-mon history reset; clears the executed flag.

positive.requirement: a new mon starts with fresh history

negative.requirement: the same mon keeps its streak

AITrackSeenPlayerMove.summary: Reveal tracking at the player's real moveset slot.

positive.requirement: the used move is recorded at its slot

negative.requirement: a zero selected move is never recorded

AIUseFullHeal.summary: Trainer item routine: Full Heal for a status.

positive.requirement: used on a statused ace with no win on the board

negative.requirement: vetoed when the selected move reliably KOs (B6)

AIUseFullRestore.summary: Trainer item routine: Full Restore: checks full post-heal HP; the status-cure line survives.

positive.requirement: full post-heal HP is what is checked

negative.requirement: status cure still used when the heal alone is futile

positive.requirement: used when the class routine rolls it

AIUseHyperPotion.summary: Trainer item routine: Hyper Potion, same payoff gate.

AIUsePotion.summary: Trainer item routine: Potion, gated by heal payoff at T2+.

positive.requirement: used when the heal changes survival

negative.requirement: skipped when the heal still dies

AIUseSuperPotion.summary: Trainer item routine: Super Potion, same payoff gate.

AIUseXAttack.summary: Trainer item routine: X items via AIIncreaseStat: cap and KO gates.

negative.requirement: skipped when capped or when the player would KO

AIUseXDefend.summary: Trainer item routine: X Defend via AIIncreaseStat (same gates as X Attack).

AIUseXSpeed.summary: Trainer item routine: X Speed via AIIncreaseStat (same gates as X Attack).

Plan_AgilityWrap.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Agility then trap; attempts keyed to the player's party slot (B3).

positive.requirement: qualifies with both moves and room to work

negative.requirement: attempt counter restarts against a new target
nonessential setup loses to a sleep payoff

Plan_AmnesiaRest.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Amnesia with Rest recovery.

negative.requirement: does not run when the setup is pointless

positive.requirement: qualifies when the trade is favourable

negative.requirement: does not run into a Substitute

Plan_Bruiser.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): the default attack plan when no other plan qualifies.

negative.requirement: never outranks a real plan's directive

Plan_ChanseyStall.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): paralysis plus recovery stall.

positive.requirement: qualifies when losing (player KO threat) and faster

Plan_ParaSweep.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): paralyse, then attack.

positive.requirement: paralyses a healthy target, then switches to attacking

negative.requirement: does not re-paralyse once the target is paralysed

positive.requirement: sleep payoff outranks nonessential setup when slower

negative.requirement: sleep legality ignores Normal/Ghost damage immunity, respects real status immunity

Plan_SubSetup.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Substitute then any boost class.

positive.requirement: qualifies with a Substitute and a boost

negative.requirement: no boost class: does not run

Plan_SubStall.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Substitute plus recovery or poison stall.

positive.requirement: qualifies with a Substitute and a rider

negative.requirement: does not run below Substitute HP

Plan_SwordsDance.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Swords Dance then attack.

positive.requirement: qualifies with the boost and a physical attack

Plan_ToxicStall.summary: T3 plan (fitness + run): Toxic plus recovery stall.

negative.requirement: Bridge immunities block it whoever moved last
an immune first match does not hide a later legal one
